report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - FOOTHILL MUTUAL WATER COMPANY (State SWS CCR template, report date 06/24/2026)

sources_described: Groundwater from the South Well, 15930 Foothill Ave, Morgan Hill, CA 95037. The source assessments identify vulnerabilities to typical activities like local fertilizer/pesticide usage and nearby wastewater sources.

extraction_notes: State small-water-system CCR template. Tables 1-3 on PDF page 4, Table 4 on page 5 (copper row continues on page 6), Table 5 on page 6, violations Table 7 on page 7. Table 1 (E. coli) was left as unfilled template text ('[Enter No.]') and was omitted. 'Level Detected' is not labeled as an average, so value_basis is 'level detected'. Many rows are from an 11/16/2023 sample (sample_year 2023). The PHG column for the secondary table repeats the SMCL value and the TTHM PHG is printed as 80; copied as printed. No nitrate MCL exceedance is reported for 2025 (6.8 mg/L, range 6.2-8.3) even though the State Water Board consolidation materials describe a long nitrate history; only monitoring violations are disclosed.
